# user-before-feature

Name who hurts, what they do today, and what better looks like before proposing features or models.

**When:** Scoping MVP, adding AI, or expanding beyond a thin slice.

**Why:** Features are candidates. Value is evidence that a user outcome improved.

**Do not:** Treat competitor checklists or demo appeal as product evidence.

Cite this principle by id when it changed a decision. Keep the citation specific.
